0.original: Rral Soj has a new order of business to discuss.

1.original: Rral Soj has tasked you with crafting tortilla presses for Aunt Tii's Tacos.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 210. Delivering items with a rating of 430 or more will earn greater rewards.

2.original: You deliver the tortilla presses to Rral Soj. Aunt Tii soon arrives to pick them up, and is pleased to see her bulk order was finished in time─no thanks to Papawni, unfortunately, who was so fixated on crafting a flawless press, that she only managed to make a single one. It seems Rral Soj will still need your help for now.

24.original: Deliver the tortilla presses to Rral Soj.

48.original: I never realized it would warm my heart so, to be thanked directly by a patron... It's a wonderful feeling!

50.original: Thanks to our last client, word of our efficiency seems to have spread, and a new bulk order has come in. I trust I can still count on your help?

51.original: So, what's the request this time?

52.original: ...A large order o' tortilla presses for Aunt Tii's.

54.original: What? You've never heard o' Aunt Tii's Tacos? It's one o' the most popular taco places in the city.

55.original: I see... But are tortilla presses normally ordered in bulk? Surely her stock didn't break all at once...?

56.original: This is somethin' of a special case. Seems the manufactory in charge o' Tii's tortilla production's havin' a complete overhaul, and everythin' needs replaced─spares included. She wants us to prepare as many presses as possible.

57.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I'd like you to make six o' 'em. Papawni and I'll handle the remainder.

58.original: Tii entrusted this order to my shop 'cause she has faith we'll get the job done in a timely fashion. Let's show her what we're made of.

59.original: You've got it! I'll do my best to make sure she leaves just as satisfied as our last customer!

60.original: As I understand, the most crucial factor is to ensure each tortilla is pressed to a uniform size... This may require some metalworking wizardry!

61.original: I'll be hard at work craftin' my share o' presses when I get a spare moment from tendin' the shop. Soon as you have your share ready, just say the word.

62.original: Ah, finished already, have you? Aunt Tii is sure to be satisfied with this handiwork.

63.original: Ah, finished already, have you? This has jus' the right amount o' weightiness to it, an' the surfaces look perfectly flat. I daresay Tii will steal whatever competition is left with the tortillas she makes from these.

64.original: Everyone, meet Tii. Tii, meet the team.

65.original: Hello, hello! I'm Tiisol, the proud owner of Aunt Tii's Tacos! It's lovely to meet you all. Your lightning-fast work with the presses is an absolute <hex:021A020203>godssend<hex:021A020103>─I can't thank you enough!

66.original: We'd been using only hardwood presses at the manufactory till now, but I can't tell you how many times I've had to order replacements. The things seem to break at the slightest bit of force! Having metal presses will be a huge relief.

67.original: I promise you these can take a beatin', and then some.

68.original: Oh, I don't doubt it! And, seeing as you've proven yourself a woman of your word, you'll be the first person I come to for my cooking supplies from now on!

69.original: Now then, I must be getting these presses to the manufactory, so I'll excuse myself here. Do be sure to visit my store next chance you get─would be a shame if you didn't get a taste of the tortillas you had a hand in making!

70.original: We'd never have been able to fulfill the order in time if not for you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. My thanks.

71.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, Mistress Rral Soj... I am so, so sorry. Once again, I was too slow. I only managed to prepare a single press...

72.original: Papawni. You put your heart into your work. I can see that.

73.original: But if you're gonna continue to work here, you need to come to grips with the stipulations o' the job. Truth be told, I need you outputtin' the same amount as <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> here.

74.original: I've been watchin' you work. You spend far too much time devotin' your attention to a single item.

75.original: I-I'm sorry! I was so thrilled to see my efforts appreciated before, I thought that if I put my all into these presses as well, Mistress Tiisol would be overjoyed...

76.original: I wanted to make them flawless and easy to maintain, and in the process...I completely lost track of the time.

77.original: I admire that you're trying to make the best product possible, but sometimes a customer only wants a tool that works─and they want it quick. Try to keep that in mind next time.

78.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, looks like you're not rid of me yet. I can't rely on your help forever, but for now, please continue to lend us your expertise.

79.original: Rral Soj is delighted with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Marvelous Metalworker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

80.original: The next request will be available from Rral Soj upon reaching level 95 as a blacksmith, armorer, or goldsmith.
